tables.maa_product_products:
CREATE TABLE `maa_product_products` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'Internal immutable Product identity generated by the database',
  `code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Stable immutable Product business key; unique in the package identity namespace and permanently reserved after soft deletion',
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive' COMMENT 'Product lifecycle status; exact lowercase active or inactive; independent of deleted_at',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application when the Product is created',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on mutation, soft delete, or restore',
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on soft delete; NULL means not deleted',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_products_code` (`code`),
  KEY `idx_maa_product_products_status_deleted_id` (`status`,`deleted_at`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_products_code` CHECK ((regexp_like(`code`,_utf8mb4'[^[:space:]]') and (char_length(`code`) <= 100))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_products_status` CHECK ((cast(`status` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'active' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'inactive' as char charset binary))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Product commercial identity and lifecycle; owns no price, stock, supplier, category, or slug'
tables.maa_product_product_contents:
CREATE TABLE `maa_product_product_contents` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'Internal immutable Product Content identity generated by the database',
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Internal Product identity owning this Content; no Host-table reference',
  `language_code` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Nullable language identity: NULL is unlocalized Content; non-NULL is exact-language Content; Host owns semantic language support and fallback',
  `language_code_identity` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci GENERATED ALWAYS AS (coalesce(`language_code`,_utf8mb4'')) STORED COMMENT 'Generated uniqueness key mapping the unlocalized NULL identity to one database value',
  `name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Product name for the unlocalized or exact-language Content; stored text, not HTML',
  `short_description` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Optional short Product description; stored content value, never rendered or sanitized by Product',
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT 'Optional Product description; stored content value, never rendered or sanitized by Product',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application when the Content is created',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on Content mutation, soft delete, or restore',
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on soft delete; NULL means not deleted',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_product_contents_identity` (`product_id`,`language_code_identity`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_maa_product_product_contents_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `maa_product_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_product_contents_language_code` CHECK (((`language_code` is null) or (regexp_like(`language_code`,_utf8mb4'[^[:space:]]') and (char_length(`language_code`) <= 16)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_product_contents_name` CHECK (regexp_like(`name`,_utf8mb4'[^[:space:]]'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Unlocalized and exact-language Product Content keyed by Product and nullable language identity'
tables.maa_product_options:
CREATE TABLE `maa_product_options` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'Internal immutable Option identity generated by the database',
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Internal Product identity owning this variant-defining Option',
  `code` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT 'Stable immutable Option business key; unique within its Product and permanently reserved after soft deletion',
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive' COMMENT 'Option lifecycle status; exact lowercase active or inactive; independent of deleted_at',
  `display_order` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Business-controlled positive order within the Product scope; assigned by the Product application through maatify/persistence',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application when the Option is created',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on mutation, ordering, soft delete, or restore',
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on soft delete; NULL means not deleted',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_options_product_code` (`product_id`,`code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_options_id_product` (`id`,`product_id`),
  KEY `idx_maa_product_options_product_status_deleted_order` (`product_id`,`status`,`deleted_at`,`display_order`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_maa_product_options_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `maa_product_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_options_code` CHECK ((regexp_like(`code`,_utf8mb4'[^[:space:]]') and (char_length(`code`) <= 100))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_options_display_order` CHECK ((`display_order` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_options_status` CHECK ((cast(`status` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'active' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'inactive' as char charset binary))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Variant-defining Product Options with stable codes; candidate key (id, product_id) serves composite foreign keys'

tables.maa_product_variants:
CREATE TABLE `maa_product_variants` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT COMMENT 'Internal immutable Variant identity; canonical sellable-unit reference for external domains',
  `product_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL COMMENT 'Internal Product identity owning this Variant',
  `composition_fingerprint` char(64) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'Immutable lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the canonical V1 composition string; unique per Product across all history',
  `sku` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Optional secondary SKU identifier; NULL or non-empty; unique while assigned; not a Variant identity or an external reference',
  `barcode` varchar(128) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Optional secondary barcode identifier stored as a string to preserve leading zeroes; NULL or non-empty; unique while assigned',
  `status` varchar(20) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL COMMENT 'Variant lifecycle status; exact lowercase active or inactive; independent of deleted_at; assigned explicitly by the application',
  `display_order` int NOT NULL COMMENT 'Business-controlled positive order within the Product scope; assigned by the Product application through maatify/persistence',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application when the Variant is created',
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on mutation, ordering, soft delete, or restore',
  `deleted_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT 'Host Clock timestamp assigned by the Product application on soft delete; NULL means not deleted',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_variants_product_fingerprint` (`product_id`,`composition_fingerprint`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_variants_id_product` (`id`,`product_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_variants_sku` (`sku`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_maa_product_variants_barcode` (`barcode`),
  KEY `idx_maa_product_variants_product_status_deleted_order` (`product_id`,`status`,`deleted_at`,`display_order`,`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_maa_product_variants_product` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `maa_product_products` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_variants_barcode` CHECK (((`barcode` is null) or (regexp_like(`barcode`,_utf8mb4'[^[:space:]]') and (char_length(`barcode`) <= 128)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_variants_display_order` CHECK ((`display_order` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_variants_fingerprint` CHECK (regexp_like(`composition_fingerprint`,_utf8mb4'^[0-9a-f]{64}$')),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_variants_sku` CHECK (((`sku` is null) or (regexp_like(`sku`,_utf8mb4'[^[:space:]]') and (char_length(`sku`) <= 128)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_maa_product_variants_status` CHECK ((cast(`status` as char charset binary) in (cast(_utf8mb4'active' as char charset binary),cast(_utf8mb4'inactive' as char charset binary))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Sellable-unit Variant identity with immutable composition fingerprint; candidate key (id, product_id) serves composite foreign keys'
